top_apps.name: 999SLCaligo
top_apps.description_short: 999SLCaligo is a number merging mobile game.
top_apps.description_excerpt: 999SLCaligo is a vertical number-merging puzzle mobile game that combines sliding combinations with board management. Players face a 5x5 thorn garden, sliding up, down, left, or right to merge flower tiles of the same value, doubling them: low-level tiles are budding florets, then bloom into four-petal flowers, then condense into outward-spiking thorn stars, and finally rise to crown blossoms that extend beyond the grid. New flower tiles continuously drop into empty spaces; successful merges score points, while invalid slides trigger a brief vibration. The goal is to merge to 2048 to clear the level. If the board fills up with no adjacent merges possible, the round ends. The controls are very accessible, but reserving space, planning merge order, and positioning high-level tiles require foresight. Pause, restart, and high-score records are also available for repeated attempts.

top_apps.description_short: Super casual department store management mobile game
top_apps.description_excerpt:
《時尚百貨城》是一款超休閒的百貨經營手遊。每次逛街看到百貨商場裡琳瑯滿目的店鋪，是不是也會幻想自己當老闆的樣子？是不是常常跟閨蜜手牽手逛街，卻發現每家店都差不多，怎麼都找不到讓人眼睛一亮的那種店？來來來～在這裡，你真的可以當老闆，親手打造屬於自己的時尚百貨城！從一間小小的快餐店開始，用你獨到的經營腦袋，把商場裡那些快倒店的鋪子一間間救回來——讓冷清的服裝店變成網美打卡熱點，把積灰塵的玩具店改造成潮玩集散地！遊戲結合了店鋪經營、夥伴養成、時尚換裝、美美家裝⋯⋯玩法超豐富，讓你在輕鬆歡樂的氣氛裡，爽爽體驗擴張事業的激情，享受變成富婆的樂趣！

【自由經營，打造商業傳奇】
從小小快餐店起步，你的每一點努力都會讓你離「富婆夢」更近一步！開連鎖超市、高級服裝店、盲盒公仔城⋯⋯每種店都有不同的經營玩法，考驗你的腦力～隨著資金和經驗一直累積，你還能直接把整座商場買下來，把每一家店都變成爆紅名店，成為真正的商業大亨！

【百變時尚，定義專屬風格】
在時尚之都，你的形象就是你的招牌！超多套潮流時裝隨便你搭——休閒運動風、奢華晚禮服、街頭潮酷、甜美森林系，想換就換！還有自訂家裝玩法，不只打扮自己，還能打造屬於你的超狂豪宅！

【夥伴助手，助力經營擴張】
一個人的力氣有限，但有一支神團隊就能無敵啦～招募並培養各行各業的菁英——金牌銷售員、天才設計師、行銷專家⋯⋯他們都會變成你的最強幫手！還有機會簽約唱跳全能的偶像明星當代言人，讓你的品牌紅遍全城！

【休閒放鬆，享受富婆生活】
忙著經營之餘，也要記得享受生活喔～可以自由逛街補貨，或在自己的私人豪宅裡耍廢放空。遊戲是輕鬆的放置玩法，利用零碎時間就能輕鬆管理你的時尚百貨城，超讚的啦！

※本遊戲內容涉及性、菸酒、戀愛交友情節，依遊戲軟體分級管理辦法分類為輔導15級，十五歲以上之人始得使用。
※本遊戲為免費遊戲，但遊戲內另提供購買虛擬遊戲幣、物品等付費服務，請依個人興趣及能力進行適度消費。
※請注意遊戲時間，避免沉迷，長時間進行遊戲，容易影響作息，宜適度休息及運動。

【About the game】
Rummy Joyland is a classic four-player rummy practice table. You and three opponents share one standard 52-card deck. Draw, meld, and discard to empty your hand first.

【Deal】
• Each player receives 7 cards
• One card starts the discard pile; the rest form the stock

【Your turn】
• Draw from the stock or take the top discard
• Lay valid melds: sets (3–4 cards of the same rank) or runs (3+ consecutive cards in one suit)
• End your turn by discarding one card

【Going out & scoring】
• Empty your hand after melding and a final discard to win the round
• Score equals opponents’ remaining deadwood points
• Face cards = 10, Aces = 1, number cards = face value

top_apps.description_excerpt:
Are you ready to observe the unknown?

Welcome to Dreamcore Anomaly Stalker, a psychological horror surveillance game where your attention to detail is your only lifeline. You are trapped in a mysterious monitoring station, tasked with a chilling objective: observe live camera feeds from surreal, nostalgic liminal spaces. But be warned—these dreamcore environments are not as peaceful as they seem.

Your job is to carefully monitor the cameras for any anomaly. The scenes may look like perfectly still, pastel-colored dreamscapes, but reality here is fragile. A misplaced object, a sudden distortion, or the terrifying presence of a stalker can appear at any moment. You must memorize the "idle" state of every room, field, and endless hallway. When a shift occurs, report the anomaly immediately before it's too late.

If you fail to observe the changes, the psychological horror intensifies. The mysterious stalker thrives on your mistakes, slipping through the camera feeds and getting closer with every anomaly you miss.
